## United States Hosts

Depending on the provider, your eligibility, and the platform's tax-form setup, a tax form may be available. See [PayPal tax-form delivery guidance](https://www.paypal.com/us/cshelp/article/how-do-i-get-a-paper-copy-of-my-tax-form-help672) and [Stripe tax-form delivery guidance](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/express-dashboard-taxes). Before filing:

- Keep your tax information current with your payment provider. Follow your account’s instructions; [Stripe’s tax-form guidance](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/express-dashboard-taxes) explains its update process and availability limits.
- Check your provider’s current tax-form eligibility rules for the relevant tax year and location. See [PayPal’s US tax-form guidance](https://www.paypal.com/us/cshelp/article/how-do-i-get-a-paper-copy-of-my-tax-form-help672) and [IRS Form 1099-K guidance](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/understanding-your-form-1099-k).
- Check which income to report and when to file and pay. Start with the [IRS gig-economy tax guidance](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/gig-economy-tax-center). If California tax rules apply to you, also review the [California FTB guidance](https://www.ftb.ca.gov/file/business/industries/gig-economy.html).

Contact your payment provider directly with any questions about your tax forms.
reviews.finding: Advice checked against Stripe’s update guidance, including access and platform-configuration limits. No universal editing control or Vast account configuration is asserted.
reviews.limits: This checks advice and source applicability only. It does not determine any host’s tax status, form eligibility, filing correctness, payment, withholding or provider-account configuration.

reviews.context:
</Frame>

When a report appears, treat it as a machine-health or contract-quality signal, not permission to inspect renter data. See [Hosting Agreement — Operation and Maintenance](https://cloud.vast.ai/host/agreement). Start with host-side evidence:

- Review user reports with [`vastai reports <machine_id>`](/cli/reference/reports).
- Pull daemon-side instance logs with [`vastai logs <instance_id> --daemon-logs`](/cli/reference/logs) when you have the affected instance ID.
- Check the host daemon log with `sudo tail -n 100 /var/lib/vastai_kaalia/kaalia.log`.
- Check kernel GPU, PCIe, AER, and Xid logs for hardware or driver symptoms.
- Compare the report with the machine's listing, port range, storage setup, recent maintenance, and any active contract terms.
reviews.finding: Advice and rule checked: begin with host-side evidence, and do not treat a report as permission to inspect renter data. The Agreement’s Operation and Maintenance section expressly prohibits reviewing Authorized User data.
reviews.limits: This checks the recommendation and the published prohibition on reviewing Authorized User data. It does not establish report accuracy, a completed investigation, runtime enforcement or any host action.

source_bindings.excerpt: Downloading, storing, reviewing, printing, or saving of the Authorized User’s data is strictly prohibited.
source_bindings.source_locator: Operation and Maintenance — Downloading, Storing, or Printing
source_bindings.support_rationale: Directly supports the no-review-of-renter-data rule; the report-handling recommendation is separately reviewed as advice.

reviews.text: - The [Certified Data Center program](https://vast.ai/data-center-application), under Priority Placement, describes higher search placement for certified machines.
reviews.context:
## Benefits

- Vast's [January 2024 datacenter article](https://vast.ai/article/Navigating-Data-Center-Compliance) describes a blue datacenter label.
- Secure Cloud search eligibility, described under Secure Cloud (Trusted Datacenters) on the [Compliance page](https://vast.ai/compliance).
- The [Certified Data Center program](https://vast.ai/data-center-application), under Priority Placement, describes higher search placement for certified machines.
- The [Certified Data Center program](https://vast.ai/data-center-application), under Dedicated Support, describes direct access to Vast’s team for onboarding, troubleshooting, and operational support.

## Requirements

- Confirm the applicable certification requirement with Vast's datacenter Product/Compliance team: the current [Compliance page — Secure Cloud](https://vast.ai/compliance) says ISO 27001 and SOC 2 are encouraged but not strictly required, while the [October 2024 security article — Third-Party Certifications](https://vast.ai/article/security-and-compliance-at-vast-ai) describes ISO 27001 as a minimum. These published sources differ.
- Equipment must be owned by a registered business. See [Certified Data Center program, Verified Business](https://vast.ai/data-center-application).
- For Secure Cloud datacenter partners, the [Compliance page](https://vast.ai/compliance), under Auditing & oversight, describes audits of ownership structure, identity, and source of funds. The [Certified Data Center program](https://vast.ai/data-center-application), under Verified Business, separately requires equipment owned by a registered business and owner identity verification.
- A signed expanded hosting agreement with Data Processing Agreement coverage, as described under Legal & Contractual Protections on the [Compliance page](https://vast.ai/compliance). Obtain the current datacenter agreement during the application process.
- Owner identity verification. See Auditing & oversight on the [Compliance page](https://vast.ai/compliance).
reviews.finding: The published program describes higher search placement for certified machines; actual ranking and reliability were not observed.
reviews.limits: This checks the published program statement only. It does not establish actual search ranking, reliability, support delivery, certification, eligibility or any completed business check.

source_bindings.excerpt: Certified machines are auto-sorted higher in search results, so enterprise customers find you first.
source_bindings.support_rationale: Supports the attributed published search-placement description; not measured ranking, guaranteed traffic or reliability.
